translations.web: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle; for my wrath is on all its multitude.
translations.bsb: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.
translations.kjv: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude
translations.asv: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but none goeth to the battle; for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
